title: 1. MAX of every parameter
rule: Every knob at its upper bound: R_in 40 mm, PCM fraction 30 %, flow 0.050 kg/s, densest packing (staggered).  N follows from R and fraction (the 30 % cap at R = 40 mm gives N = 105).
why_not_optimal: Radius and fraction were ALREADY at their bounds in the optimum (R 40 mm, 29.6 % of a 30 % cap), so the only real changes are +1 capsule and a higher flow (0.050 vs 0.0388). The gain is marginally higher but the difference sits INSIDE the repeatability band, so the funnel treats it as a tie and breaks it on cost: more PCM mass, more capsules, more overheating.
